title: Infleqtion
summary: Neutral-atom quantum company working on computing, sensing and clocks.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Infleqtion builds neutral-atom quantum computers, atomic clocks and quantum sensors, using laser-cooled atoms as qubits and as precision instruments. Its portfolio spans computing and sensing, which broadens commercial exposure beyond gate-model quantum computing. The company has supplied clocks and sensors to government and defence customers.

Technology Exposure

  • Neutral-atom quantum processors
  • Optical atomic clocks
  • Quantum sensors and RF receivers

What To Watch

  • Atom-array scaling
  • Government and defence contracts
  • Funding runway

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
